يتعاطف (form VI)
# يَتَعَاطَفُ (yataʕāṭafu) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# يَتَعَاطَفَ (yataʕāṭafa) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# يَتَعَاطَفْ (yataʕāṭaf) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤaf/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa
